scope_rule.fixed_suite_preserved: All 35 CONTROL_LABELS (2 outer + 6 inventory + 27 retained), every mutation, every expected-exception set, every reason fragment, every baseline obligation, and every unavailable predicate in boundary_controls.py are preserved verbatim. No control is narrowed, renamed, re-targeted, or dropped.
scope_rule.permitted_edits: Only plumbing changes are permitted: new files, new additive functions, callable wiring, report/plan field shape, argv schema, controller phase validation, budget rows. No original model, reducer, guard, profile, or checker edit. No semantic change to audit_inventory or boundary_audit.audit.
scope_rule.non_additive_claim: The report claim reservation_units_are_not_additive is REFUTED as a general property and must be removed. Every unit consumed by every baseline, mutation, survey and wrapper fixture call is a fresh scientific unit that must appear in the nonrefundable global ledger. Exactly two reviewed identities to already-reserved units are permitted (see global_ledger_mapping.identities); no other collapse is admitted.

defect_resolutions.summary: Reprice the inventory-control layer lawfully instead of paying 7 x 40512 full-enumeration calls. Add audit_inventory_membership (192 symbolic units per call) to inventory_audit.py; route all six inventory mutations plus the membership baseline through it; evidence the full-path positive baseline by the retained inventory-auditor dependency rather than a redundant 40512 call. See budget_arithmetic for the exact fit.
exact_checks: audit_inventory_membership exists in inventory_audit.py, is exported, takes exactly 192 symbolic units per call (one take(1) before each of the 192 selected-member revalidations), and never enumerates the 40320 orders.

For each of the six inventory mutations, the rejecting predicate exists verbatim in audit_inventory_membership AND in audit_inventory (superset argument, reviewer-verified line by line); the rejecting-predicate table in this plan must be reproduced in the reviewed source.

Command accounting key control_inventory_membership_units == 192 * (1 + len(INVENTORY_LABELS)) == 1344 in plan row, phase command, argv literal, reservation row and report; all five representations equal.

Any future inventory-layer control whose detection requires the 40320-order enumeration must be charged at 40512 per call in the plan; if that charge makes the grand total exceed 5000000 the configuration is REFUSED, not silently repriced.
counterexamples: A plan whose control command accounting omits control_inventory_membership_units or declares it < 1344: reject at budget-plan validation.

A mutation that changes only a non-selected order's contribution to whole_inventory_sha256 while selected stays consistent: audit_inventory_membership cannot detect it; proposing it as a membership-path control is refused (must be full-price 40512 or absent from the fixed suite).

A durable plan listing 'wrapper-fixture' inside local_control_limits: refused (double-charge shape).

defect_resolutions.summary: Define semantics exactly: unavailable-reachable-witness is neither detection nor failed detection; it makes that label untestable on the bound shard. Add a cheap witness survey command (adapter --survey) charged control_survey_units; the control run is admitted only after the survey's owned audit PASS shows every CONTROL_LABEL available on the exact bound bytes. A run that still reports INCOMPLETE cannot satisfy the control obligation: the payload contract requires status CONTROL_PASS plus suite_status COMPLETE_FIXED_CONTROL_SUITE, so incomplete output fails admission and is retained nonrefundably.
exact_checks: witness_survey(inventory_raw, result_raw, expected_indices, charge) is a new public function in boundary_controls.py that builds all candidate controls and emits {label: {available: bool, reason: str-or-null}} for all 35 labels plus all_required_witnesses_available; it calls no auditor, takes at most 4*len(indices) survey units (one per certificate bound-decode pass and one per availability decision), and its output is a pure function of the bound bytes.
Survey command accounting is exactly {planning_fixture_calls: 4096, control_survey_units: 4*len(indices)}; it depends on the same inventory, inventory-auditor and explore producers as the run.

The control run mounts the survey output, requires --survey-sha256 equal to its output_sha256, and the run report's per-label availability map must equal the survey map exactly; any mismatch is a tampering/nondeterminism signal and refuses the run.

Pass criteria: only status CONTROL_PASS with suite_status COMPLETE_FIXED_CONTROL_SUITE, all_required_controls_detected true, failed_controls == [] and unavailable_reachable_witnesses == [] satisfies the control obligation; incomplete suites are campaign-fatal for validation (no validated publication) but not a crash: the attempt is retained, the reservation is not refunded, and the only lawful remedy is a distinct pre-planned command over a different shard whose survey passed.
If no surveyed shard offers all required witnesses, no run is admitted and the campaign reports the control obligation unmet; this is an explicit refusal, never a silent skip.
counterexamples: Run payload with suite_status INCOMPLETE_FIXED_CONTROL_SUITE or status COMPLETE_FIXED_CONTROL_SUITE under /status: contract requires /status == 'CONTROL_PASS'; fails admission of the payload.
A phase that admits the run without a survey dependency or with --survey-sha256 not equal to the mounted survey output: refused.
A plan treating unavailable controls as passed or shrinking CONTROL_LABELS: refused as suite narrowing.

defect_resolutions.defect: grok-major-6 retained control charge scales with shard count/size without a finite admitted budget
defect_resolutions.summary: Controls run once per campaign over one bound retained shard, never per-shard. Enumeration: retained reservation per call is 192 + 35*len(indices); calls are 1 baseline + 27 retained labels = 28. At n=24 worst case (192+35*24)*28 = 28896; at n=4 it is 9296. Per-shard replication across the 16-shard sweep and any configuration whose grand total exceeds 5000000 are explicit refusals with arithmetic in budget_arithmetic.
exact_checks: The budget plan contains at most one control run command per bound shard plus its declared repeat policy; per-shard control replication across the 16 sweep shards is refused by ceiling arithmetic (retained layer alone would be 16*28896 = 462336 at n=24).
history_indices of the control run equal its bound explore shard's ordinal list, 1 <= n <= 24, distinct, 0 <= index < 384.

control_retained_audit_units == (192 + 35*n) * (1 + 27) declared worst-case; actual LocalControlCounter retained limit may be lower only because fewer labels are available, and then the run is incomplete and fails admission anyway, so the plan must always reserve the worst-case 28 calls.
Any demand for controls on more than one shard is refused unless the recomputed grand total still fits 5000000; the arithmetic must be shown, not asserted.
counterexamples: Sixteen role=control commands one per sweep shard: refused, exceeds ceiling.
Control run with len(indices) > 24: schema refusal.
Plan reserving (192+35n)*(1+available) with available computed pre-survey < 27: refused; worst-case 27 retained mutations must be reserved.

Command accounting for every control-side command (survey and run) includes planning_fixture_calls == 4096 exactly once; the envelope fixture_accounting.limit == 4096 and calls <= 4096 with by_function summing to calls.
Report field wrapper_fixture_kernel_calls_in_durable_plan is replaced by accounting_ownership; no field may imply the module consumed or reserved the fixture units.

Adapter + 7 membership calls + up to 28 retained calls + imports together must keep envelope calls <= 4096; if the survey command observes calls approaching the limit it must be reported, and a command whose envelope hits the limit fatals via the wrapper, retaining the reservation.

defect_resolutions.defect: grok-minor-8 outer binding bypassed for semantic controls
defect_resolutions.summary: Preserve the separation deliberately: semantic mutations operate on decoded objects, so routing them through a byte-hash check would only ever prove hash rejection, never auditor discrimination. The adapter supplies outer_binding as a real byte-binding layer: sha256 of the mounted inventory/result bytes must equal argv --expected-inventory-sha256/--expected-result-sha256 which the phase manifest binds to the producers' output_sha256 values; mismatch raises an error containing 'outer-binding'. The controller's own dependency verification remains the mandatory outer gate; the in-module baseline plus two append-byte controls are the discrimination evidence.
exact_checks: Phase manifest requires --expected-inventory-sha256 equal to the inventory producer's bound output_sha256 and --expected-result-sha256 equal to the bound explore output_sha256.
Both OUTER_LABELS controls must be rejected by the adapter binding with reason containing 'outer-binding'; the baseline on unmutated bytes must pass.

Every non-outer control report shows target in {'inventory-auditor','retained-auditor'} and never 'outer-binding'; report field outer_binding_bypassed_for_semantic_controls stays true with the limitation text.
The inventory-auditor membership callable additionally receives the independently audited whole digest via --expected-whole-sha256 bound to the inventory-auditor payload's whole_inventory_sha256.
counterexamples: A semantic mutation reported with target 'outer-binding': misattribution, control fails.
expected-sha argv not equal to the mounted dependency output_sha256: refused at phase validation.

relation_non_narrowing.rule: Per validation-contract: empty source names, empty pairs, equal live generations and current-stage freshness must never become premises of the accepted staged-identity disjunct. Controls must not introduce them.
checks: cross-case-stage-proof (label 21) only rebinds an existing identity proof's case field to a different real admitted case name; it creates no empty name, no empty pair, no generation equality premise.

staged-identity-misused-as-authority (label 22) flips incarnation_pair_established_by_identity false->true on an actual original-object-identity prefix; it mutates a flag on real retained evidence and detection must come from the unchanged audit_case typed replay, not from any new premise.

No control, adapter code, auditor addition or report field may treat name equality, empty pairs, equal live generations or stage freshness as evidence of identity acceptance; the accepted relation and checker are untouched.
Reviewers must diff the staged-identity disjunct predicate paths end to end after repair and confirm zero changes.
counterexamples: A control asserting staged identity because source names match or pairs are empty: refused premise.
A control where identity acceptance is inferred from equal live generations or current-stage freshness alone: refused premise.
A mutation whose only rejecting path is a newly added premise: refused; detection must ride the unchanged typed replay.

unresolved_preserved: Actual unavailable-witness rates on real 24-history shards are unknown until artifacts exist; the survey mechanism exists precisely because this cannot be settled analytically.

Whether reviewers accept the two identities to already-reserved units (I1, I2) is an open review question; rejection collapses to the refusal configurations, not to silent repricing.
The inherited complete 87-command gates remain Windows-host-bound; every native result is partial validation only.
No accepted controller yet maps local precharges into the global ledger; this plan specifies the required revision but admits nothing.
Margins (27795 primary) assume the packet constants; any added command, repeat or control consumes them and must be recomputed exactly.
dissent_notes: A reviewer may reasonably insist each inventory mutation exercise audit_inventory itself rather than the membership subset; under that reading no ceiling-fitting configuration exists and the correct outcome is refusal of the control suite, not a cheaper claim. The superset-predicate argument in this plan must be verified line by line before reliance.
Keeping (192+35n) per retained call is deliberately conservative; a memoized-membership collapse was considered and rejected as unnecessary reliance on an unadmitted identity.

The survey command adds a command and a 4096 fixture reservation; folding survey into the run would save it but would burn the full run reservation whenever witnesses are missing, so separation is retained.
limitations: Source-only plan: nothing here was imported, executed or measured; all arithmetic is analytic from packet constants.
The adapter, membership function, survey function and controller revision do not exist yet; this plan specifies them and their exact checks.
No claim of scientific admission, execution, control results or acceptance is made; the packet remains BLOCKED_NO_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZED.
budget figures use worst-case all-available retained labels; actual charges may be lower only in configurations that would then be incomplete and refused anyway.
